question: Which agency supported the Bihar State Rural Livelihoods Mission (Jeevika) in developing digital financial services?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SIDBI**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Bihar State Rural Livelihoods Mission (Jeevika) received support from **SIDBI** in developing digital financial services.
 
• SIDBI, or the Small Industries Development Bank of India, is a development financial institution in India, focused on the growth and development of micro, small, and medium-scale enterprises (MSMEs).
 
• Through its support, SIDBI aims to enhance financial inclusion and access to credit for rural communities in Bihar.
 
• Digital financial services developed under this mission include mobile banking, digital payments, and other financial technologies that facilitate easier access to financial services for rural populations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SIDBI** was established on April 2, 1990, through an Act of the Indian Parliament.
 
• The primary objective of SIDBI is to provide refinance facilities and short-term lending to industries, and it acts as the principal financial institution for the promotion, financing, and development of the MSME sector.
 
• SIDBI also plays a significant role in promoting innovation and entrepreneurship in the MSME sector by providing various financial products and services.
 
• In addition to financial support, SIDBI offers capacity-building services and technical assistance to MSMEs to enhance their competitiveness and sustainability.
